FOLIO.Name: Hero name
FOLIO.SpellHint: Combine runes, gestures and inflections via “Cast Spell”.

ToggleQuickbar.name: Sheet & Quickbar: switch sheet and quickbar
ToggleQuickbar.hint: For the character of the selected token, or your own character: opens its quickbar or switches between the full sheet and the quickbar.

EndTurn.name: Sheet & Quickbar: end turn
EndTurn.hint: Ends your turn in the current combat. The GM can end any turn.

UseButton.name: Sheet & Quickbar: quickbar button {n}
UseButton.hint: Uses button {n} of the open quickbar, exactly like a click.

UiLanguage.name: Language
UiLanguage.hint: Choose whether Sheet & Quickbar follows Foundry or uses a fixed module language.

QuickUse.name: Quick mode
QuickUse.hint: Clicking actions and skills rolls at once without a dialog; with Shift the dialog appears. Off: the other way round.

Theme.name: Color scheme
Theme.hint: Dark or light look of this module's sheets and quickbars.

Background.name: Background
Background.hint: Background of the sheet: a solid color, the image of the standard Crucible sheet, the Ember codex, or transparent so the map shows through. The quickbar keeps its own background.

BackgroundOpacity.name: Opacity of the transparent background
BackgroundOpacity.hint: How much the sheet covers the map (0.3 = very see-through, 1 = opaque). Only applies to the “Transparent” background.

CompactMode.name: Compact mode
CompactMode.hint: Smaller type, icons and spacing – more content in less space. Applies to the sheet and the quickbar.

QuickbarOpacity.name: Quickbar opacity
QuickbarOpacity.hint: Opacity while the mouse is elsewhere (0.2 = very transparent, 1 = opaque). Fully visible on hover and on your turn.

HeaderDblClick.name: Double-click the title bar
HeaderDblClick.hint: Switches between sheet and quickbar. Off: Foundry default (minimize the window).

ConditionRounds.name: Remaining rounds on conditions
ConditionRounds.hint: Shows the remaining rounds of a condition in the header and the quickbar.

CostPreview.name: Cost preview
CostPreview.hint: Hovering an action pulses the action, focus and heroism points it spends; missing points turn red.

RepeatSpell.name: “Repeat last spell”
RepeatSpell.hint: A button in the spells tab and the quickbar which casts the last spell again.

SpellDialogStrip.name: Spellbook in the spell dialog
SpellDialogStrip.hint: Shows the strip of saved spells in Crucible's spell dialog, to load and save compositions.

HostileHealConfirm.name: Ask before healing enemies
HostileHealConfirm.hint: Asks before healing (e.g. a healing elixir) is applied to an enemy.

QuickbarTargets.name: Target in the quickbar
QuickbarTargets.hint: Shows targeted tokens with defense and distance; click pans to the token.

TargetChecks.name: Mark unsuitable actions
TargetChecks.hint: Marks quickbar buttons which cannot be used on the current target (range, flanking …) and names the reason.

TurnQuickbar.name: Quickbar on your turn
TurnQuickbar.hint: Opens your hero's quickbar automatically when it is their turn in combat.

TurnAnnounce.name: Announce your turn
TurnAnnounce.hint: Announces “It's …'s turn!”, lets the quickbar glow briefly and tells you when you are next.

CombatBar.name: Combat bar
CombatBar.hint: When an adversary's turn begins, its quickbar opens in a fixed place and follows each adversary turn. The bar remembers its position.

AutoFillAdversaries.name: Fill adversary quickbars
AutoFillAdversaries.hint: Adversaries without own favorites get their attacks, abilities and Defend in the quickbar.

SheetMode.name: Use Sheet & Quickbar for
SheetMode.hint: Applies to you only – other players and the GM see their own choice. Switch single characters by right-clicking them in the actor directory or in the ⋮ menu of their sheet.
SheetMode.chosen: Only characters chosen one by one

WorldDefault.name: Default for everyone
WorldDefault.hint: Applies to everyone who chose “As set by the GM”. With “Nobody” the module changes nothing for anyone until they choose it themselves.

FOLIO.StatusNeedsSource: “{name}” needs a source creature and cannot be applied directly here.
FOLIO.RelativeHint: Enter a value – or relative: “-7” for damage, “+5” for healing

SPELLFAV.Title: Spellbook
SPELLFAV.SaveHint: Save this combination to the spellbook
SPELLFAV.RemoveHint: Saved – click to remove it from the spellbook
SPELLFAV.Empty: Empty: choose rune, gesture and inflection, then click “Save”.
SPELLFAV.BookEmpty: No saved spells yet. Add them with “Create Spell” or save them right in the spell dialog.
SPELLFAV.CastHint: Cast – the dialog opens pre-filled (Shift: cast now)
SPELLFAV.CreateHint: Compose a spell and save it to the spellbook without casting it
SPELLFAV.NoComponents: This hero knows no runes or gestures.
SPELLFAV.RenameHint: A custom name for this entry. Leave empty to use the spell name.
SPELLFAV.Name: Custom name

FOLIO.NeedsToken: “{name}” is placed on the map: your token needs to be on the current scene.

QB.ToQuickbar: To quickbar (or double-click the title bar)
QB.Restore: Open the full sheet (or double-click the title bar)

FOLIO.EndTurnHint: End your turn and pass to the next combatant

SELFTEST.Title: Self-test
SELFTEST.Hint: Renders every hero and a random sample of 20 adversaries off-screen (full and as quickbar) and checks the integration with Crucible and Ember. Run it after every update.
SELFTEST.Summary: Sheet & Quickbar self-test: {count} sheets checked, {failed} with problems, {integrations} integration notes.
SELFTEST.NewVersions: Sephral’s Crucible Sheet & Quickbar was tested with older versions. New: {versions}. Please run the self-test in the module settings (gear in the sheet header).
SELFTEST.SpellDialog: SpellCastDialog not found, the spellbook strip in the dialog is missing
SELFTEST.SpellDialogHook: Spell dialog patch not active (fallback through the render hook)
SELFTEST.SpellAction: CrucibleSpellAction not found, the spellbook cannot cast
SELFTEST.Attunement: Ember is active, but no Attunement tab was found
SELFTEST.Sample: Adversaries: random sample of {tested} out of {total}.

FOLIO.MaintainedCost: Maintained: {cost} Focus at the start of each turn
FOLIO.Delayed: Delayed: acts at initiative {to} instead of {from} this round

HostileHeal.Title: Heal an enemy?
HostileHeal.Content: {action} restores Health or Morale, but your target is an enemy: {targets}. Continue anyway?

SHEET.UseStandard: Use the standard sheet (just for me)
SHEET.ConfigLegend: Sephral’s Crucible Sheet & Quickbar – just for you
SHEET.ConfigHint: Applies at once and only to you – other players and the GM see their own choice. The settings below apply to everyone.

MIGRATION.Done: Sephral’s Crucible Sheet & Quickbar took over the data of “Crucible Folio” ({actors} actors). The old module can be disabled.
MIGRATION.LegacyActive: “Crucible Folio” is still active – that is the earlier name of Sephral’s Crucible Sheet & Quickbar. Please disable “Crucible Folio”; the new module then takes over all data.
